name: af-hub-platform-tests
description: Checks that projects stay apart: rules, configs, the migration tool, and the tracker pages end to end.

scripts.test:local: node config.test.cjs && node migrate.test.cjs && node rules.local.test.cjs && node hub-rules.local.test.cjs && node e2e/run.mjs --backend=fake
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only database,auth,storage --project demo-afhub "node rules.emulator.test.mjs && node migrate.e2e.mjs && node e2e/run.mjs --backend=emulator"
